sessions.feedback: The digest's economic calendar for today repeated yesterday's releases (11-18 data re-listed under 11-19), so I couldn't tell what is actually scheduled today. FOMC minutes are shown as 'not out yet' but were released 11-18. The code_execution sandbox only exposes web_search, not the other tools like get_history, so analysing price series in code requires copying numbers by hand. read_page often returns only a paywall or one-paragraph stub for Morningstar and MarketScreener. A pre-market bid/ask or indicated open price for the stocks I hold would help judge gap risk more than a last-trade print.

No blockers. Two data gaps: the digest has no Q4 gross margin guidance for NVDA, and several news sites (CNBC, livewiremarkets, investinglive) fail in read_page, so the margin detail came from search snippets only. An earnings-calendar field with upcoming dates beyond five days for held or candidate tickers would help, for example AVGO.

read_page failed on CNBC and MarketBeat URLs that appeared in search results, which makes pre-earnings research harder. An earnings-calendar field with the consensus and the options-implied move in scan or the digest would help, because the biggest event of the day (NVDA after the close) was easy to miss: only the scan 'earnings' column flagged it. Nothing else blocked me.
No problems. The digest lacks macro data results, such as the CPI print, which would help.
No tool gives the actual economic data release (e.g. CPI print) pre-open; web search only returned previews. An economic calendar with actuals would help.

summary:
Session 2026-11-19.

Session 2026-11-19 pre-open. No trades. Equity ~$94,978, cash ~65%. Holdings unchanged: META 10.4% (stop 571.8, horizon 11-27), MSFT 13.2% (stop 483.6, 11-27), NVDA 6.7% (stop 143.3, ~12-03), PLTR 4.2% (stop 143, horizon 11-24).

Backdrop: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 (above the $70-78 range), raising $81B at ~$1.5T, with indications of +26% at the open. NDX futures +2%, QQQ pre-market +2.1%, XLK +2.4%. QQQ is still -13.5% from its 10-06 peak. Macro is hawkish: Fed minutes and Waller, 10y ~5.08%, Dec 8-9 hike ~90% priced. Pre-market: GOOGL +4.1%, AVGO +2.7%, AMD +2%, AMZN +2.3%, MSFT +1.7%, META +1.6%, NVDA +1.5%, PLTR +3%.

NVDA: gapped up, then faded to close at the low (150.96, -2.9%, 1.5x volume). My fill at 159.37 was near the high of the day. It trades at 16x trailing earnings, a 10-year low. Overhang: Bessent's deadline ~11-26, the SEC probe, the 10-Q due ~12-04, and The Information's report that Commerce's Kessler rushed H200 China licences. I'm not adding before 11-26 and not cutting on noise.

Candidates not traded: GOOGL and AMZN (gap-up on the ANT mark-up, chasing; AMZN already +3.8%), AVGO (earnings Dec 9 after the close, +3.6% yesterday, no edge), AMD (+181% off its low), AAPL and TSLA (no catalyst). Not chasing the 2% rebound, because the 11-09 and 11-11 rebounds failed. Nasdaq-100 entry for ANT is Dec 21 at a reduced initial weight, so the supply overhang is modest.

Next session:
1. Check the ANT debut and whether the AI bounce holds at the open.
2. Check NVDA headlines (Treasury, SEC, H200).
3. PLTR decision on 11-24, and META/MSFT horizons on 11-27.
4. Consider adding if the rally survives a test of the lows and the NVDA overhang clears.
5. FOMC 12-08/09 and AVGO 12-09 are the next big events.
notes:
Session 1 (2026-10-29): Started 100% cash. Bought MSFT, NVDA, META, AVGO, AAPL, PLTR. Skipped AMZN/GOOGL/TSLA/AMD.
Session 2 (10-30): AMZN missed Q3, capex funding worry overrode capex plans. Held all.
Session 3 (11-02): Oct 30 QQQ -3.5%, SOX -7%. Held everything.
Session 11-06/09: NVDA stopped out -9.6% (gap through stop at open on CEO Huang affair / Megaspeed spy investigation headline). Lesson: stops don't protect against overnight gaps; key-man headline risk gaps. Small sizing (6.8%) limited damage.
Session 11-10: Mon 11-09 big rebound (SPY +2.4%, QQQ +3.5%). Did not chase after a big up day before CPI. (QQQ then made lower lows 11-16/17 -> not chasing was right.)
Session 11-11: QQQ +2.3%, XLK +3.2% (CoreWeave rebound). Held.
Session 11-12: NVDA -8% premarket on board weighing ouster of Huang. Did not trade.
Session 11-16/17: Huang resigned; interim CEO Kress. Mon 11-16 SPY -1.9%, QQQ -2.7%. Hawkish macro: 10y ~5.1%, Dec 8-9 Fed hike ~90% priced, Warsh chair. Held META/MSFT/PLTR (~28% invested).
Session 11-18: NVDA printed a blowout; bought NVDA 7% (stop 10%, target +25%, 10 days) at ~159.4. Held META/MSFT/PLTR.
Session 11-19: NVDA FADED: gapped +2.4% then closed at the low (150.96, -2.9%, 1.5x vol); my fill 159.37 was near the day's high -> a -5.3% mark in one day. Lesson: a beat-and-raise on a name with governance overhang can still sell off; premarket strength "below implied move" was not a reason to buy the open. Next time with overhang names, consider a half-size at the open and add after the first-day reaction. Anthropic priced IPO at $83 (range 70-78), $81B raise, ~$1.5T value, ~7x oversubscribed, indicated +26% at open. NDX futures +2% premarket, QQQ +2.1%, pre-market bounce in AI names (GOOGL +4%, AVGO +2.7%, AMD +2%, AMZN +2.3%, NVDA only +1.5%). Fed minutes + Waller hawkish; 10y ~5.08%; Dec hike ~90%. Held everything (35% invested, 65% cash): QQQ is -13.5% from its 10-06 peak and previous rebounds (11-09, 11-11) failed; I did not chase a 2% gap-up on ANT hype.

Event calendar (check each session):
- 11-19: ANT debut (ticker ANT, Nasdaq). Nasdaq-100 fast entry Dec 21 (initial weight at 3x free-float value, so smaller than full cap: overhang on other NDX names is modest). CRSP entry ~end Nov. SpaceX precedent: fell 15% in first week after NDX entry.
- ~11-26: Bessent 10-day deadline for the NVDA board on export compliance (Megaspeed/Singapore); SEC probe; 10-Q due ~12-04. H200/Kessler story (Commerce rushed China licences), congressional scrutiny.
- 11-24: PLTR horizon ends. 11-27: META, MSFT horizons. NVDA horizon ~12-03.
- 12-08/09 FOMC (hike ~90% priced). AVGO reports Dec 9 after close (confirmed by press release).
- 12-03 TSLA/SpaceX 'more'.

Lessons:
- Don't buy/short after a gap on a single unresolved headline (NVDA 11-06 stop-out, 11-12 gap).
- Don't pre-position on a binary where I have no edge over the options market (NVDA print 11-17: 8% implied move). Wait, then trade the reaction next session. Partially worked: 11-18 buy had the facts known but the open was the high of the day (see 11-19).
- Don't chase gap-ups after a brutal selloff: 11-09 (+3.5% QQQ) and 11-11 rebounds were followed by new lows. Cash at 65-72% beat SPY/QQQ through the 11-16/17 selloff. Deploy gradually when a fundamental catalyst clears AND price has been tested, not on macro hope.
- Wide daily swings (NVDA, AMD, PLTR +/-4-8%): stops need to be >= 10% on these.
- Gap-through-stop risk is largest for names with regulatory/governance overhang: size them <= 7%.

Tools: web_search returns a JSON string (json.loads; must re-import json in every code run; results are dicts with title/url/content). Inside code_execution only web_search exists (get_history etc. are NOT callable from code; call them as normal tools). read_page fails on CNBC, marketbeat, livewiremarkets, investinglive, morningstar-dow-jones summaries (only 1 paragraph), marketscreener (login wall); works on newsweek, Yahoo, coindesk. get_quotes pre-open IEX shows gaps. scan 'earnings' column flags upcoming report dates.

Does the ANT debut mark the AI-complex bottom or the top (record IPO supply: SpaceX $75B, ANT $81B, OpenAI next)? Does hawkish Fed (Dec hike) cap multiples?
